en:
These ruins are so quiet... It
doesn't look like any traps are
active or that anything has
made a nest here.

Coro made such a fuss about
some unnatural readings here
that we all came to check it
out... but it seems it was for
nothing.

Coro is a worrywart AI. He
tends to overreport even the
smallest reactions; this is
probably just more of the
same.

It's too early to let our guard
down. Ruins of advanced
civilizations can look dormant,
but you never know when
they'll spring to life.

Haha, the words of an
experienced traveler really
carry weight. But still... I
wonder what kind of ruins
these are.
Which planet did Coro say had\na similar pattern? Um, S...?
Planet Stream. The planet that\nhad the Time Gate...
...del. To Fidel...
...? Rena, did you just call me?
No? But I could have sworn I\nheard a girl's voice...
Ugh, what is this feeling!
Ah, Brother Fidel! I heard the\nfish dishes here are famous!\nWant to eat some with me?
Fidel_now: ...Miki!? Why are you\nhere! And what are you talking\nabout...?
Fidel_past: No... I'm fine.

Geez, you still can't eat fish? If
you're a picky eater, Relia's
going to laugh at you, you
know?
Fidel_now: W-what is this! Miki\nand... another me?
Fidel_now: No, I remember this.\nThis was a conversation I had\nwith Miki in Santerol...!
Fidel_past: I can eat fish! ...I'm\njust not fond of it.
That's exactly what being a\npicky eater is.
Are you still dwelling on that\ntime you ate the fish we\ncaught in the river?
Fidel_past: ...Ugh. Please don't\nremind me...
It disappeared... What was\nthat? A hallucination? Or a\ndaydream...?
Fidel... You don't like fish?\nWhy? It's delicious!
Could everyone else see that\ntoo? And Lati, that's not the\nimportant part right now, is it!?
...That strange sensation again!\nAnd the surroundings are\nchanging too...!
This can't be... This is right\nnear Sthal Village... It's my\nhometown...!
Big brother Fidel still can't eat\nfish guts. Even though they're\ndelicious.
...Guts?
The innards. For small fish,\nthey're usually cooked without\nremoving them.

A long time ago, when Big
brother Fidel grilled and ate a
fish he caught in the river, an
earthworm from the bait just
popped out of the guts...
Hey, don't remind me of that!
The guts are the best part, so\nit's a waste.
...I remember this conversation.\nJust what is this ruin...?

*Pant, pant*... We barely
managed to win. Still, those
enemies and the place we
fought... it feels like everything
is from my memories.

Yes, they vanished once we
defeated them, but they
weren't illusions. You felt it too,
didn't you, Claude?

It was quite different from the
Battle Simulator, wasn't it? I
wonder if it's manifesting
things from our memories as
physical entities.

I didn't sense any malice,
though. The enemies were
determined, but they fought us
head-on...

And the memories being
recreated... they all seemed to
be, you know, the ones without
any malice.

...You don't have to be so
considerate. Everyone knows
I'm not fond of fish. It's not like
the reason is a secret now...
...But why were only those\nkinds of memories played\nback? For what reason...?
Doctor: Captain, Dorne's\ncondition is...!
...I recognize that voice! Is this...\nmy memory? If so...!

...I knew it. This is the medical
bay of the Space Battleship
Karnas. And over there, in that
transparent bed, is Dorne,
who's starting to turn to
stone...
...They're here. Ronyx... and the\npowerless version of me from\nback then.
Doctor: His vital organs have\nbegun to petrify. He is in\ncritical condition.
Dorne...!
...Mr. Ronyx. I... I have a\nrequest.
What is it?
...At least, let me spend my\nfinal moments at home...
Final moments? Don't talk like\nthat... You're just going to\nsleep for a little while.
But if we can't get the serum...
Please.
...Very well.
Prepare for transport.
Doctor: Yes, sir.
Please let us go with Dorne\ntoo.
You all...
We'll make sure to come back.
Actually, there's something I\nwant to give you before the\nend.
What are you talking about?\nYou're only going to be asleep\nfor a little while...
Please get that music box on\nthe shelf over there.
I want Millie to have it.
But this belonged to your\nsister... I can't take it.
Please... take it...
That... my sister... I...
It's okay. I promise I'll save you.
...Dorne!
Was that Lati's memory?\n...Something painful happened,\ndidn't it?

...Yeah. But it's okay. Many
more hardships followed this,
but we overcame them. Dorne
and his home planet were both
saved.

So, while that was a painful
sight... I think it served as a
good reminder of the
happiness we have now.
I see... Lati is strong. Or\nperhaps she became strong\nthrough all those battles...

...I'd heard my father talk about
this period, but seeing it
firsthand is a completely
different experience.

Lati, I feel like I finally
understand why my father
trusted you and was always so
proud of you.

Huh, if the memories are like
this, it seems worth catching a
few more glimpses. Let's
explore a bit more.

...There must be some meaning
to the memories this labyrinth
is recreating. Even if there's no
malice... there's a meaning.

Fragments of the elements
that make a person who they
are... is that it? If so, then mine
are...
Are you all right, Edge? You\nlook pale. If you're hurt, I can\nheal you...
Eh, no, I'm fine. I just...\nremembered something\nunpleasant...
...Ugh!
This place is... the Bridge of\nthe Space Exploration Vessel\n003, the Karnas... I thought so.

That means "now" is around
Space Calendar year 10. Right
after "that planet" vanished...
And the one slumped over in
the captain's chair... is me,
back then.

I saw it right before we were
swallowed by subspace... The
moment the distorted Earth...
vanished into the light...
Earth, which had miraculously\nbecome what it was... over the\ncourse of 4.6 billion years...
Vanished... in a single instant...\nSo easily...

It is impossible to stop a
runaway annihilation. That...
was something no one could
have stopped.
That's right, no one could stop\nit! But... I'm the one who\ncaused it!
That's not true, Edge!
E-tan!
Edge, you tried your very best!
Stop trying to comfort me!
Even if that wasn't our Earth, it\ndoesn't change the fact that\nit's gone...
That's right... it all vanished! My\nwrong decision is what caused\nthem to spiral out of control!
Earth was annihilated! Not a\nsingle thing left! Everything!
Everything!

The adults! The children! The
animals! The towns, the houses,
all of it! Everything! Everything!
Everything, everything,
everything!
Aaaagh! Uaaaagh...!!
Stop it, E-tan! Please, stop it!
This isn't why I went into\nspace... I did it for everyone's\nhappiness... for the future...
And yet...!
Mista Edge, this is not your\nresponsibility alone. We are\nalso at fault.
He's right... None of us were\nable to stop them...
So, Edge...
If only I hadn't been involved...
If only I hadn't handed over our\ntechnology...
Edge! Edge, pull yourself\ntogether! If you feel sick, it's\nokay to throw up!
I'm... I'm okay. I'm fine now. It\nwas just a reflex, I've calmed\ndown...
Still, a materialized flashback is\npretty brutal...

Unlike my memories, this isn't
funny. And it's not as easy to
move past as it is for Lati... is
it?
I'm sorry, Edge. If only I hadn't\nsuggested we keep exploring\nout of curiosity...!
...It's okay. What I experienced\nwas incredibly sad and\nirreversible, but...

...It was worth it. I was able to
leave something meaningful
behind in this universe. The
Uncharted Planet Protection
Treaty only came to be
because of these events...

...Yeah. That philosophy has
been passed down until Space
Calendar 772. I'll keep it going.
Now, and forever...
...Right. I'm counting on you for\nthe future.

Now, let's get back to
exploring. If we can share and
understand each other's
precious memories... then that
can't be a bad thing.

Meeting Rena and everyone
else. Growing so much. Saving
the universe. I have so many
happy memories, but...

...The secrets of our birth, the
destruction of our hometowns.
The grueling battles... There
are many painful memories as
well.
I'm a little anxious about what\nwe're going to see.
Ah... this is the shop in my\nhometown, Aria Village. Opera\nis there too...

I remember now! This was
shortly after I met Claude.
Opera and I were looking at
accessories while talking about
the people we loved!
Hmm. So you've never received\none, Rena?
In that case, try acting a bit\nspoiled in front of a boy you\nlike. I'm sure he'll give you one...
...Let's see. For now, how about\nClaude?
If it's a request from the cute\nRena, I think he'd do almost\nanything for you.
What...?! I couldn't possibly do\nthat!
Oh, really?
Really! I'd be far too\nembarrassed!
You're actually happy, aren't\nyou?

I am not! I'd really be troubled!
If Claude gave me something, it
would honestly just be...
awkward...
Oh...
Claude...
Hello? Claude...?
It seemed like you two were in\nthe middle of something...
D-did you hear that...?
W-well, I have some things to\ntake care of, so...
W-wait! That's not what I\nmeant, Claude!
How sweet and innocent.
I'm getting hives just watching\nthis.
Isn't the vibe here completely\ndifferent from what I was\nshown...?

It's embarrassing! So
embarrassing! I'm so naive! It's
frustrating that I can't just be
honest with my feelings!

Whoa! Rena, who was perfectly
fine watching her life turned
into a stage play by her
friends, is now totally
squirming!
I suppose it has a different\neffect when it's played back as\nyour own image.

(I feel like this is different from
my memories... but for the sake
of my own sanity, it's probably
best not to dwell on it...)

Hmm, I'm not sure what the
criteria are for the ruins to
playback memories... but I have
a feeling I'm the last one.

There are some memories I'd
rather not show, but it's too
late for me to be the only one
hiding things. Though I really
hope it skips over any
embarrassing mistakes I made
as a kid.

I wonder how far back the
memories go. If it's millions of
years, maybe we could even
see memories of my real
mother...
Just the past... I wonder. These\nruins seem related to the Time\nGate, so maybe...
This place... is it some noble's\nestate? It looks familiar, but I\ncan't quite place it...
Oh, there I am with Adray! And\nClair... is she making tea for\nme?
Well? Have you grown\naccustomed to life here yet?
Yeah. Mostly... it's all thanks to\nyou, Adray.
I see. That is good to hear.
By the way. Are you... seeing\nthat girl from Nevel, Nel?
Wh― *cough cough*! Where did\nthat come from?
You went out of your way to\nstay here. I assumed as much...\nam I wrong?
N-no, it's not like that. Nel and I\naren't... that.

She was the first person I met
on this planet, and we've
adventured together... How
should I put it... yeah, she's
more like a comrade to me.
In that case, Master Fayt. Do\nyou happen to have a partner\nat the moment?
Not really... but why do you\nask?
I see. Then this is perfect. How\nabout marrying my daughter?
What!? Clair?
What, is she not to your liking?
No, it's not that. But isn't that\nsomething she should decide\nfor herself?
Even if I said yes, I don't know\nhow Clair would feel about it...
What nonsense. I know my\ndaughter well. There is no way\nshe would refuse.
Right, it's settled! Now the\nLarsbird family's future is\nsecure.
Hm? Clair. What is it?
What?! You want me to follow\nyou? Perfect. I have something\nto discuss with you as well...
I don't dislike Clair, but... that\nwould mean that guy is my\nfather, right?
No matter how you look at it,\nthat's just... no.
Fayt, when did things progress\nthat far between you two?\nAnyway, congratulations.

Have you told Sophia about
this? You've got to settle your
relationships properly, or you'll
be in for some trouble!
...I don't know, I don't know! I\nhave no memory of this!\nBelieve me!

I suspect... the memories
played back here aren't just
past facts. Some might be
possible futures or from
parallel worlds.
I agree. Considering the\nenemies and the battlefields,\nEdge is probably right.

...If that's the case, this is a
precious ruin! I think we should
take more time and explore it
carefully!
True! Alright, let's head back\nfor now and bring the captains!
This is a huge discovery. For\nonce, Coro's exaggerated\nreports were actually spot on!

M-maybe we should destroy
this thing before any more
weird memories play... Actually,
I really want to destroy it...

I totally agree, and I can
already imagine the chaos that
would ensue... but given the
mood, I don't think we can just
break it...

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
